title: Bee Removal Services in West Orange, NJ
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nest removal in West Orange, NJ. Licensed technicians treat nests in wall voids, soffits, and attics. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal throughout West Orange, New Jersey. Our licensed technicians identify the stinging insect, locate the nest, treat it directly, remove accessible nest material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization. Active nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, chimneys, or wooden structures require immediate treatment — a wasp or hornet nest inside your structure will not go away on its own.
whyUs: With over a decade of experience serving the West Orange community, Best Pest Control NYC combines local expertise with advanced bee removal techniques that protect both your property and the environment. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
localContext: West Orange's mix of historic Victorian homes, mid-century properties near Eagle Rock Reservation, and modern developments around the Thomas Edison National Historical Park creates diverse environments where wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets commonly establish nests in eaves, soffits, chimneys, wall voids, and older wooden structures. The area's tree-lined residential streets and proximity to the South Mountain Reservation provide abundant nesting opportunities for carpenter bees in exposed wood and yellow jackets in ground burrows during warmer months.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in West Orange, NJ?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in West Orange?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my West Orange property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency service throughout West Orange, with most appointments available within 24 hours of your call. Simple nest treatments are typically completed in 1–2 hours, while nests inside wall voids or requiring structural access may take longer. We work efficiently to restore safety to your property as quickly as possible.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects do you treat in West Orange?
faqs.answer: We treat wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, bald-faced hornets, paper wasps, carpenter bees, ground bees, and bumble bees throughout West Orange and Essex County. Our technicians identify the species and locate the nest, then use the appropriate treatment for each situation — whether it's a yellow jacket nest in your wall void, a hornet nest in your attic, or carpenter bee galleries in wooden trim around your home.
